### Capium Hub

			Print

	Modified on: Thu, 12 Sep, 2024 at 12:21 PM

		Capium Hub is a platform designed to enhance collaboration and communication between Accountants and Customers. There are two elements to the Capium Hub; Business Web & Business App. 

Download the Business App on Android

Download the Business App on the Apple Store

Through the Business Web, you will find features such as Document Sharing/Storage, a simplified Bookkeeping (Sales & Purchase invoices), a Client Request portal and more. Through the App, you will find the Receipt & Document Scanning, Sales & Purchase invoicing and many more features.

To provide your clients with access to Capium Hub, you will need to create them as a Capium Client User. Click here to learn how to add a Client User.

The aim of this article is to give you an understanding of how best to use Capium Hub to improve your practices' efficiencies. 

Accountant Profile

Accountants will have access to the Business Web Dashboard Analytics - with readily-available data such as recent Sales & Purchases, Payroll, Corporation Tax and Submission Deadlines. 

Sale and Purchase invoices can be created from the respective areas as seen below (invoices created are for the Accountant and not clients)

Sales

You can record the Invoice by navigating to 'Sales' and clicking on 'Raise Invoice'.

Items

You can add items by navigating to Sales > Items > Add Items

Purchases

You can record the purchases by navigating to 'Purchases' and clicking on 'Record Purchase'.

Purchases > Payments

You can add payments by navigating to Purchases > Payments > New payments.

docscan

You can view all Docscan records by navigating to Purchases > Docscan. To utilise Docscan please download Capium Business App.

Contacts

You can add in the customers and suppliers here by selecting 'Add Customer' or 'Add Supplier'

View Documents

Documents shared by clients can be viewed from the Documents > 'Saved Files'

Client Requests

View Request tickets sent by clients under Your Accountant > Client Requests

Client Profile

Clients will also have access to the aforementioned features on the Business Web - with the only differences being that clients can send requests to Accountants from the Client Requests section as well as having the option to share and store documents.

Client Access

The Business App is designed for just clients, with the aim of enhancing accountant-client collaboration. The app houses our Receipt and document scanning tool (DocScan), which will scan and send directly to the accountant in real-time. The app also has Dashboard Analytics (as shown below) with readily-available data such as recent Sales & Purchases and Corporation Tax.

Clients can also take advantage of the various forms of communication available from the app such as direct SMS, Email and Client Request function by clicking on the Icon on the top right.

Click here to watch a walk-through of Capium Hub

### Capium Business App (Soon to be replaced with Capium 365)

			Print

	Modified on: Fri, 13 Jun, 2025 at  3:28 PM

		Capium's Business App has been replaced with Capium 365. We will soon deprecate this mobile app and fully replace this with Capium 365. More on Capium 365 can be found here https://www.capium.com/products/capium365/

Here is also an article on how to get setup 

You can book a demo through www.capium.com and a member of the team will navigate you through how it's your solution for digital recordkeeping and MTD

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Capium's Business App helps accountants get data quicker from their clients in order to continue with filing preparations. 

It helps clients create invoices on the go, whilst also capturing receipts in real-time straight back to the accountant. It helps in line with Making Tax Digital (MTD) to speed up receiving transactions  

The Capium Business App  also houses DocScan, a tool designed to scan physical receipts, pick up the values and send to the accountant in real-time. Using the Bulk Upload feature, you are also able to take photos of up to 10 receipts or choose 10 photos from the gallery to upload to the Accountant. 

The app can be downloaded from the Apple Appstore and Google Playstore - just search Capium Business App

Watch the video here to find out more on Capium Business App

### How to bulk download Docscan receipts

			Print

	Modified on: Tue, 13 Jul, 2021 at  3:04 PM

		Location:

Hub >> Select customer >> Purchases >> Docscan >> Filter dates to find the receipts >> Click on 'Export As' and select the format of the download

Video Tutorial:

Click here to watch how to bulk download Docscan receipts

Help Guide:

Navigate to the Hub module from the ecosystem, 

Select the customer for which the receipts need to be downloaded.

Click on purchases >> Docscan 

Enter a 'From' and 'To' date to filter the scanned receipts 

Click on the 'Export As' dropdown box to select the format you want to download the receipts

			Print
cleanText:
Solution home 
		Capium Hub
		Capium Hub Overview

### How to approve Docscan receipts

			Print

	Modified on: Fri, 23 Jul, 2021 at 11:44 AM

		Location:

Purchases >> Docscan >> Find the transaction >> Using the drop down box select 'Record' >> Select nominal ledger >> Click on save and close. 

Video Tutorial:

Click here to watch how to approve a scanned receipt 

Help Guide:

From the client dashboard, go into 'Purchases' and then 'Docscan'. 

Use the search function to find the scanned receipts. 

Find the transaction and using the drop down box, click on 'Record'.

The system will automatically enter the amount of the receipt onto the invoice as well as attach the scanned receipt. 

The final step is to select the nominal account to post this transaction into and click on 'Save & Close'.

### How to allocate a licence to a customer

			Print

	Modified on: Wed, 13 Oct, 2021 at 12:39 PM

		Location:

Create a user > My Subscription > Hub > Find user and switch hub access to 'Yes' 

Video Guide:

Click here to watch how to allocate a licence to a customer

Help Guide:

The first step is to create a client user. 

Go into My Firm > Users > New User.

Please note, the email and password that you create are the credentials yours customers will use to log into the mobile app. 

To assign this user a license, go into My Subscription > Hub 

You'll see the client user created in the list below. 

Switch Hub access to 'Yes' to give the client access to log into the mobile app.

### How does a Client User change their password?

			Print

	Modified on: Thu, 27 May, 2021 at 10:36 AM

		Please click here to watch how to change your password as a client user

Location: My Admin > Profile > Profile Settings 

To change your password whilst already logged into to your account, head to My Admin

This is the person icon in the top right hand corner

You will then enter into an admin portal

Please click on profile on the left hand side, please then click on change password

Please type in the original password given to you by your accountant

Please type in a new password, confirm the password and click save.

### Client information - Creating sales and purchase invoices

			Print

	Modified on: Fri, 23 Jul, 2021 at 11:46 AM

		Location:

Sales invoice 

Hub module >> Sales >> Invoice >> Raise invoice 

Purchase invoice

Hub module >> Purchases >> Purchases >> Record purchase 

Video Tutorial:

Click here to watch how to create sales and purchase invoices 

Help Guide:

Your clients can raise sales and purchase invoices from their side by logging in and going into the Hub module.

Sales Invoice

Navigate to 'Sales' and then 'Invoices'.

To create a new sales invoice click on 'Raise Invoice'.

Enter in the details of the invoice and click on 'Save'.

Purchase Invoice 

Navigate to 'Purchases' and go into the 'Purchases' tab.

To create a new invoice, click on 'Record Purchases'. 

Enter in the details of the invoice and click on 'Save'.

Once your clients have created the invoices, they should reflect in the bookkeeping module.
